scope: production cutover of forward drizzle v2: runner wiring, host CPU fallback port, band-level resume through the gate-7 store, real production runs; legacy record/sort/candidate path removal only after acceptance

selection.mechanism: TC_FORWARD_DRIZZLE_V2=1 selects the v2 producer in FORWARD_DRIZZLE; the choice is recorded in the v2 run plan and run provenance; the phase checkpoint carries forward_drizzle_v2 + plan_hash so a resume keeps the originally selected producer
selection.default: env unset keeps the legacy producer until the removal commit

store_contract.layout: plan.json + band-%04d.bin + band-%04d.profiles.bin + checkpoint.json + commit.json + current.json per generation
store_contract.profile_records: 80 B ForwardDrizzleV2ProfileResult, channel-major, same order as pixel records; committed atomically with the band transaction
store_contract.publication: current.json published only after the commit gate passes; nonfinite_pixels_inside_source_support == 0 required

band_geometry.origin_convention: affine6 stays the persisted canvas source_to_canvas transform; band_origin_*_native shifts only emission; local-warp inversion evaluates in canvas coordinates (oracle-exact)
band_geometry.band_rows: derived from the nominal deterministic device budget and the gate-5 memory plan; plan geometry never depends on transient free VRAM; reserve() validates real capacity per band

cpu_fallback.contract: same artifacts, same band store, bit-identical discrete decisions, magnitudes within documented tolerance
cpu_fallback.restart: any device error discards the unpublished generation and restarts the entire phase on the host CPU port
cpu_fallback.test_hook: TILE_COMPILE_FD_V2_CUDA_FAULT_AFTER_BANDS forces a device fault mid-phase

resume.prefix_reuse: inspect_forward_drizzle_v2_store + adopt() reuse the committed band prefix verbatim; partially written band artifacts are unverifiable and recomputed
resume.fail_closed: corrupt band artifacts, non-contiguous checkpoints, foreign plans and ambiguous generations all reject adoption

failed_cutover_evidence.root_cause: the v2 driver executed 610 full-frame provider/decode/sigma/H2D/scatter operations for every 47-row band; the Gate-9 ring was a test-only accounting model and no source/Q reuse was wired into production
failed_cutover_evidence.verdict: production acceptance rejected by user; run stopped

revised_acceptance.legacy_comparison: v2 must be strictly faster on identical input/config/hardware
revised_acceptance.preproduction: real-provider all-band benchmark must pass before restarting A1/A2/L1/L2

preproduction_result.checkpoint_and_rgb_identity: bit-identical to rectangular and tiled optimized runs

legacy_removal: BLOCKED — final commit only after A1/A2/L1/L2 acceptance
